title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Advanced Management Thought
description: Learn about the pioneering management thinkers and their impact on modern management practices.
longDescription: Attention all aspiring managers and business leaders! Our course on Pioneering Management Thinkers will give you a historical perspective on the evolution of management theories, from Taylor's principles to Fayol and Hawthorne Studies, that have shaped modern management practices. Learn about the impact of these theories on efficiency, productivity, motivation, group dynamics, and social responsibility in organizations. In addition, our course on Organizational Behaviour and Change Management will delve deeper into human relations, social psychology, administrative relationships, cooperation, and conflicts, with a focus on managing change effectively. You will also gain advanced knowledge of Quality Management and how it impacts customer satisfaction, costs, and competitiveness. The Deming management approach and other quality management methods will be analyzed and compared. Lastly, our course on Critical Theory and Critical Realism will introduce you to an alternative approach to social realities and scientific inquiry, with a focus on achieving liberation from oppression.
